entries.title: Milestone · Wed Nov 11
items: Added strategies 18–22, all marked Aggressive: 3x Nasdaq trend (TQQQ 200-day), 3x chip trend (SOXL 200-day), Residual momentum top 10, 3x Nasdaq IBS dip-buy, and Crypto vol-targeted trend + regime gate.
Picked from 14 aggressive, less-crowded candidates backtested in a new experiment (SIFT strategy lab run_20261111) with the same costs, fills and five pre-set checks as strategies 11–17.
Each opened with $10,000 paper at the Nov 11 close (#22 at the Nov 10 crypto close). Backtest drawdowns for the 3x strategies run from −57% to −83%.
Added this Updates log and a Last updated stamp at the top of every page.
